caption:
Feel safe because everything's comfortable? False safety is the first to fall. (Amos 6:1 devotional)

Comfort built without God doesn't secure you; it numbs you to the fall. He wakes a numbed heart again.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 What comfort have I mistaken for safety — and let numb my heart?
